visual_logic.surface_detail: Smooth, hydrodynamic skin with 'Teal' and 'Seafoam Green' countershading, with shell rib-ridges beneath a leathery surface running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the powerful paddle-like limbs and the wide, flat skull oriented parallel to the camera plane.

environment.water: Sun-drenched, turquoise water over a high-albedo 'Cream White' chalk seafloor, balanced to keep the lateral outline completely measurable.
environment.biota: The floating rafts of Crinoids and drifting 'Azure' jellyfish are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, unobstructed silhouette line.

pose: The giant marine turtle is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original tilted mid-turn pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its flat skull, leathery shell, massive flippers (flattened toward the camera plane), and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
